section.title: Document Content
section.p: This guide provides detailed instructions and best practices for configuring and maintaining secure stations, covering secure communication setup with digital certificates and TLS, user authentication and password management, role-based authorization, and secure email integration. It explains how to manage certificate stores, implement PKI and client certificate authentication, configure SAML SSO and TOTP Authenticator, and use the Security Dashboard for monitoring security status. The guide also addresses secure station-to-station communication, Fox over WebSocket, auto logoff, and permissions management, enabling systems integrators to deploy multi-layered security for building automation systems.
